claims.statement: For Q=U^TBU+2U^TCV+V^TDV on two disjoint original product banks, if rank(C)=2 with nonzero singular values s1,s2, range(B) and range(C) lie in one 3D U-side subspace E, and the scalar compression lambda on E intersect range(C)^perp is nonzero, then Q has a continuous density with ||p_Q||inf < 12.01 |lambda|^(-1/4)(s1 s2)^(-3/8).

For an exact-rank-three target A=RMR^T and a full physical partition I union J with rank(R_I)=3 and rank(A_IJ)=2, the preceding theorem applies with E=range(R_I). At |lambda|>=1/64 and the fleet01/B19 compound-energy threshold e2(CC^T)>=29/3072, ||p_Q||inf<82 and the density is continuous.

claims.note: The r24 local two-gradient theorem remains valid, but a universal positive lower bound on one physical two-gradient area is false.
